items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Bill and I had a perfect understanding of why we had to go to the new world.

ctx.x: He and Red Norvo wound up with these two lifesize dummies which were part of an act. Some people they'd run across, and there were a dancer who worked with these dummies. So they outfitted -- well, at least, Bill, the one he ended up with, he outfitted him with another band uniform. And he had him sitting next to him in the trombone section, with a horn propped there. And argued with him all night on the stand.
